mapper.sql: p.id, p.request_id, p.category_id, p.name, p.description, p.type, p.price, p.stock, p.cover_file_id, p.digital_file_id, p.status, p.deleted_at, p.created_at, p.updated_at, c.name AS category_name, f.bucket AS cover_bucket, f.object_key AS cover_object_key
FROM product p JOIN category c ON c.id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN file_object f ON f.id = p.cover_file_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product (request_id, category_id, name, description, type, price, stock, cover_file_id, digital_file_id, status) VALUES (#{requestId}, #{categoryId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{type}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{coverFileId}, #{digitalFileId}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET category_id = #{categoryId}, name = #{name}, description = #{description}, type = #{type}, price = #{price}, stock = #{stock}, cover_file_id = #{coverFileId}, digital_file_id = #{digitalFileId} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE product SET status = 'OFF_SHELF', deleted_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE product SET deleted_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE p.deleted_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p.deleted_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE deleted_at IS NOT NULL

SELECT
WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.status = 'ON_SALE' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT p.id, p.request_id, p.category_id, p.name, p.description, p.type, p.price, p.stock, p.cover_file_id, p.digital_file_id, p.status, p.deleted_at, p.created_at, p.updated_at, c.name AS category_name, f.bucket AS cover_bucket, f.object_key AS cover_object_key, COALESCE(s.sales_count, 0) AS sales_count FROM product p JOIN category c ON c.id = p.category_id AND c.status = 1 LEFT JOIN file_object f ON f.id = p.cover_file_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT oi.product_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sales_count FROM order_item oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'REFUNDED') AND o.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(3), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY oi.product_id ) s ON s.product_id = p.id WHERE p.status = 'ON_SALE' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, category_id FROM product WHERE id IN #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product p WHERE p.status = 'ON_SALE' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
AND p.category_id = #{categoryId}
